meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 剪辑出品牌片、蒙太奇、片头等各类自定义视频作品。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要灵活创作非模板化的自定义视频内容。
copy.tagline_en: Produce and edit custom video pieces, from brand reels to montages.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a flexible video creation tool for original, non-templated content.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 创作或编辑自定义 HyperFrames 合成时,会先读取项目简报与已有文件,再按规范分场景规划、搭建画面与动效,并在相应阶段先出方案供确认。
howto.when: 当没有更专门的视频工作流适用,或 BRIEF.md 把 flow 设为 companion 时;典型用于较长或多场景片、品牌宣传与混剪、静态循环和标题卡等。

say.text: 把这三条素材剪成一条品牌宣传片,先给我完整分镜方案。
say.note: 该技能会先产出分镜方案再继续。

say.text: 在这个合成里把第三段素材裁到 8 秒,并加上片尾标题卡。
say.note: 会作为局部编辑处理,不重开方案。

say.text: 把这句话做成 15 秒静态标题卡,用我们的品牌配色。
say.note: 会按静态标题卡流程搭建并出预览。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude creates or edits custom HyperFrames compositions by first reading the project brief and existing files, then planning scenes and building visuals/motion per the rules, pausing at checkpoints for confirmation when needed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when no specialized workflow fits or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion; intended for longer/multi-scene pieces, brand/sizzle reels, montages, static loops/title cards, and freeform builds.

say_en.text: Cut these three clips into a brand film; give me the full storyboard first.
In this composition, trim the third clip to 8 seconds and add an end title card.
Make a 15-second static title card from this sentence using our brand colors.
